purpose: Identify the current page within a hierarchical path and provide real links to ancestors.
avoid: Avoid treating browsing history as a hierarchy.
basis: Pinned React/primitive sources lead API, lifecycle and semantics; native visual observations and explicit reference decisions are mapped in figma/traceability.json.
profileRationale: The family presents controls or navigation; static depictions do not establish an interactive contract.
sourceRule: Root is nav with default aria-label=breadcrumb; List/Item are ol/li. BreadcrumbLink defaults to anchor through useRender. BreadcrumbPage is a nonfocusable span role=link, aria-disabled=true and aria-current=page. Separator/Ellipsis are presentation and aria-hidden; the hidden More text inside Ellipsis does not make an interactive overflow control. A real overflow menu must be explicitly composed.
keyboardAndFocus: Tab visits real ancestor links; Enter follows their href. Current page and separators are not made focusable. No root arrow navigation, roving focus or path state is implemented. Caller/router supplies updated ancestors and the current page after navigation.
contentAlternative: Visible native labels, destinations and task text provide the meaning; icons, borders and position are supplementary.

visualContract.layoutPolicy: Breadcrumb binds all seven actual exports. Native 14px separator glyphs and 4px item gap are retained, with an explicit 8px wrapping-list reference gap and shared 14/20px typography. Ancestors are real href anchors; the actual current-page wrapper is a nonfocusable span with role=link, aria-disabled=true and aria-current=page, preserved rather than silently rewritten. Native presentation separators and ellipsis are hidden from accessibility. Ellipsis is not a disclosure control: this concrete fixture supplies the full hierarchy as alternative links below, instead of inventing an overflow API or hiding essential destinations. Caller can separately compose a real menu if desired. RTL fixtures explicitly set dir on Root and mirror chevrons; logical wrapping remains fluid.
